run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if a string can be split into four distinct substrings
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input strings and compare results with a filled implementation
review_f_gold: review f_gold which checks whether a given string can be divided into four non-equal substrings
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns true when a string of length 10 or more can be split into four distinct parts
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to improve the brute-force triple loop approach for splitting strings into four distinct substrings
